findings.message: Codex review of TASK-035 confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Offline autosave and cloud sync implementation is complete and properly architected.
CloudProjectSyncPort provides clean abstraction for cloud sync operations with sync_project() and is_available() methods, properly separating interface from implementation.
InMemoryCloudProjectSync adapter enables deterministic testing of sync behavior without network dependencies, maintaining test isolation.
OfflineAutosaveService implements non-blocking I/O with 30-second interval scheduling and bounded queue (MAX_PENDING_SNAPSHOTS = 8). Snapshot cloning ensures isolation from later edits.

Consent-gated cloud sync is properly implemented. Sync only occurs when cloud adapter exists, is available, AND explicit consent exists (cloud_sync or parental_control_cloud_sync_consent) on profiles.

All contract tests pass comprehensively: run_contract_tests.sh reports Contracts: 54  Checks: 696  Failed contracts: 0. New contracts (CloudProjectSyncPort, InMemoryCloudProjectSyncAdapter, OfflineAutosaveService) all passing.
Handoff documentation (TASK-035-handoff-to-claude.md) is thorough, documenting all implementation details, validation results, and acceptance criteria mapping.

checklist.codex_review: APPROVE - Codex review confirms all acceptance criteria met with APPROVE decision

acceptance_criteria.autosave_30s_non_blocking: PASS - Autosave runs every 30 seconds without blocking active interaction
acceptance_criteria.cloud_sync_optional_consent: PASS - Cloud sync remains optional and requires explicit parent consent

checklist.interval_semantics: PASS - Interval and first-schedule behavior in OfflineAutosaveService is correct
checklist.consent_handling: PASS - Consent key handling supports backward compatibility with cloud_sync and parental_control_cloud_sync_consent
checklist.snapshot_isolation: PASS - Queued snapshot isolation prevents mutation from later project edits
checklist.bounded_queue: PASS - Bounded queue behavior under repeated scheduling is correct
checklist.test_coverage: PASS - Contract test coverage comprehensive (696 checks, 0 failures)

summary: APPROVE. TASK-035 implementation and codex review are both complete and correct. Offline autosave with non-blocking I/O and optional consent-gated cloud sync are fully operational. All acceptance criteria are met. The copilot cross review confirms all findings and validates the implementation.
